name: AWS IAM
label: AWS IAM Query API (users and groups)
description: AWS IAM Query API 2010-05-08 via OfficialApiNode, signed with AWS SigV4 (service iam). Host https://iam.amazonaws.com. Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html. Operations: create-user, get-user, list-users, update-user, delete-user, add-user-to-group, remove-user-from-group, create-group, get-group, list-groups, update-group, delete-group, listen. Form body plus Action/Version in the query string. Auth secrets access_key_id, secret_access_key, optional session_token are instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). Commercial IAM signing region is us-east-1. listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_key_id, secret_access_key, or session_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"create-user"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: create-user | get-user | list-users | update-user | delete-user | add-user-to-group | remove-user-from-group | create-group | get-group | list-groups | update-group | delete-group | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'create-user'.

schema.label: UserName
schema.description: IAM user name for user ops. Example: deploy-bot.

schema.label: GroupName
schema.description: IAM group name for group ops. Example: developers.

schema.label: PathPrefix
schema.description: Optional path prefix for list-users / list-groups.

schema.label: Path
schema.description: IAM path for create-user / create-group. Example: /.

schema.label: MaxItems
schema.description: Request-body parameter `MaxItems` for operations: list-users, get-group, list-groups.

schema.label: Marker
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Marker` for operations: list-users, get-group, list-groups.

schema.label: NewPath
schema.description: Request-body parameter `NewPath` for operations: update-user, update-group.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: create-user, get-user, list-users, update-user, delete-user, add-user-to-group, remove-user-from-group, create-group, get-group, list-groups, update-group, delete-group, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: SigV4 signing region. Commercial IAM is global — use us-east-1. Host is iam.amazonaws.com (not iam.{region}).

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).
